pr.title: Check the staged vmdl hash at compile time
pr.author: Jakey-Jakey
pr.head: 285901962c123bf4de751c20df8549dfc54dc6c0

findings: Today's 0.8.26 and 0.8.27 commits (64647a6, c7e10e4) do not touch forge/compile.py, forge/stage.py, or tests/test_compile.py.

The PR check inserts against build_content, the disposable build folder removed by d26d4a1 on 2026-11-13 when compile moved in place to content/citadel_addons/<addon>. That is why GitHub reports the PR as conflicting.

The PR intent is not covered today: compile_stage reads stage.json but never compares the vmdl bytes to vmdl_blake3. operators.py calls stage.verify after staging, so an edit after staging or in the CSDK copy is not caught at compile.
supersession: No code-path supersession exists. The PR is stale, not redundant: it cannot merge, and its check still needs an equivalent at the current compiler input.
evidence: GitHub PR 1 metadata and file patch
